stories.title: Store reducer with undo/redo
stories.description: As a user, I want every action reversible so I never fear a keystroke.
acceptanceCriteria: src/lib/store.ts [NEW] exports reducer over {data: AppData, undoStack, redoStack} with actions: add, complete, uncomplete, edit, delete, snooze, undo, redo, externalReload
Every mutating action pushes its inverse onto undoStack (cap 50, FIFO eviction) and clears redoStack; undo pops, applies, pushes inverse onto redoStack (FR-36, FR-38)

delete inverse restores the task with its original order value
externalReload replaces data and empties both stacks (FR-43)
Unit tests: every action round-trips via undo to deep-equal prior state; recurring complete+undo removes spawned task; stack cap evicts oldest; all pass
Typecheck and lint pass

progress.details: store.ts reducer TDD; 30 store tests; inverse-op undo/redo cap 50; recurring complete spawns via nextOccurrence with compound inverse
progress.learnings: Inverse ops are themselves union members (restore{task,index}, markDone, revertComplete{spawnedId}); delete inverse re-inserts at original array index for deep-equal round-trips; redo re-spawns deterministically by reusing spawnedId as newId.

progress.details: Toast component + toast slice with wrapped dispatch in AppContext (every mutation toasts); 11 component tests; 25 e2e; visual gate PASS; toast screenshots inspected.

progress.details: useKeymap hook: FR-15..FR-17 focus model, FR-37 undo routing in 3 contexts, g-sequences, typeahead handoff; 20 hook tests; 30 e2e; visual gate PASS; focus-state screenshot inspected.

progress.details: Snooze: store-suite target tests (weekend-on-weekend, month boundary, undated->Scheduled), TaskRow overflow menu (Tomorrow/Next week/Weekend), key-1 snooze e2e; 262 unit, 33 e2e, visual gate PASS; menu screenshot inspected.

codebasePatterns: All colors/spacing/type via CSS variables from DESIGN-SYSTEM.md — no literals in components
Every interactive element has a visible focus-visible style (2px accent ring, 2px offset)
src/lib/ modules are framework-free: no React imports, clocks/storage/ids injected as parameters
Unit tests use generator functions (makeTask, makeAppData, makeMemoryStorage), never beforeEach mutation
Test names state concrete behavior: 'snoozing with key 1 sets dueDate to tomorrow', never 'works correctly'
No `any` in TypeScript — use real types or unknown
Date math uses local-date components from src/lib/dates.ts — never UTC ms arithmetic across days
Same-wave stories own disjoint files: views live in src/views/<View>.tsx, components in src/components/, App.tsx is owned by exactly one in-flight story at a time
Date helpers use ISO weekday numbering 1=Mon..7=Sun; all date math via local components (new Date(y,m-1,d+n,12))

Parser: pass order recurrence->date->time->list->priority, first-wins per kind, word-level whole-token matching; chip displays: date "Wed Jun 10", time "3:00 PM", list "#work", priority "P1", recurrence source text
Store: reducer(state, action) pure; mutating payloads carry injected ids/dates (newId, completedAt, today); internal inverse action types restore/markDone/revertComplete
UI: classes shell-column/masthead/view-tabs/view-tab/keycap/empty-state in App.css; tokens only; aria-current=page marks active tab; useApp() from src/state/AppContext
Component tests: // @vitest-environment jsdom pragma + src/test-setup.ts localStorage shim; probe context state by rendering a JSON <pre> probe inside AppProvider
TaskList sections prop: [{label, tasks, rollover?}]; empty sections omitted; all-empty renders empty-state line. TaskRow classes: task-row--p1/--rollover/--selected/--done
Toast: useApp().toast + showToast; wrapped dispatch emits Captured/Completed/Done — next <date>/Deleted/Snoozed to <date>/Scheduled/Saved/Reopened/Undone/Redone
useKeymap config: callbacks (onComplete/onEdit/onDelete/onSnooze/onUndo/onRedo/onTypeahead) + getRowIds reads DOM .task-row[data-task-id]; today injectable

userIntent.text: todo app that implements the best features from existing todo apps and fixes common pain points
